title: Laboratory bench
passage: A. Several workers are lifting a table. B. The equipment is stored beneath the table. C. A window has been covered by a curtain. D. A piece of equipment is on the work surface.
passageZh:
A. 數位工作人員正在抬桌子。
B. 設備收在桌子下方。
C. 窗戶被窗簾遮住。
D. 一件設備放在工作檯面上。
